title: Intermediate Inside clause for module extension by zero stalk maps
statement: For a ringed space X, open W and x in W, there is a natural O_X,x-linear isomorphism from the stalk at x of G on W (with scalars restricted along the inverse restriction-stalk ring isomorphism) to the stalk of its sheafified extension by zero. It sends every germ of a section over V in W to the germ of its image under the unit of the chosen extension/restriction adjunction, over the image of V in X.

proof.text: Proof: Construct the canonical extension/restriction adjunction by direct-sum injections on opens contained in W and the module sheafification universal property. On neighborhoods contained in W, which are cofinal at x, the presheaf has exactly one summand and its restrictions are those of G. The resulting colimit comparison, followed by the sheafification stalk isomorphism, is an additive isomorphism. Represent a scalar and a section on a common neighborhood to show linearity over O_X,x, using the inverse restriction-stalk ring isomorphism for the source action. Naturality follows from naturality of injections and sheafification. To use the particular chosen adjunction, compare the canonical adjunction with it by the unique natural automorphism of their common left adjoint compatible with units. Compose the canonical stalk comparison with the stalk of that automorphism. It remains an isomorphism, and sends a germ to the germ of the chosen unit by the unit comparison formula. This proves the displayed germ identity on every V. Source: Stacks Project, Sheaves Lemma 00A7 (2)-(3), Lemma 00A5, and Lemma 007Z.

mathlib_searches.verdict: No full match; sheafification stalk lemma is used for outside. Restriction of schemes is insufficient for arbitrary ringed spaces.

mathlib_searches.query: The stalk of sheafification of a presheaf of modules is unchanged and extension by zero has zero stalk outside the open subset

For a sheaf of modules on an open subset, extension by zero has zero stalks outside the open and the unit is an isomorphism on stalks inside; transitions between nested opens are compatible with counits
